overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Oklahoma City Thunder on winning the 2025 National Basketball Association (NBA) Finals. The Thunder beat the Indiana Pacers 103 to 91 in Game 7 on June 22, 2025, winning the series four games to three and capturing the team's first championship since moving from Seattle to Oklahoma City in 2008. The resolution highlights the team's 68-win regular season and star player Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, named the league's Most Valuable Player for both the season and the Finals. It recognizes the team's hard work and the excitement it brought to Oklahoma. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on July 29, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution celebrates a historic achievement that brought together fans across Oklahoma.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it doesn't change any law or spending.
